umm.EntryTitle: TEMPO NO2 tropospheric and stratospheric columns V04 (PROVISIONAL)

RelatedUrls.Description: DOI data set landing page for TEMPO_NO2_L2_V04

umm.Abstract: Nitrogen dioxide Level 2 (PROVISIONAL) files provide trace gas information at TEMPO’s native spatial resolution, ~10 km^2 at the center of the Field of Regard (FOR), for individual granules. Each granule covers the entire North-South TEMPO FOR but only a portion of the East-West FOR.
umm.Purpose: The Tropospheric Emissions: Monitoring of Pollution (TEMPO) V04 data products are processed using the TEMPO Science Data Processing Center (SDPC) software that is operational as of September 2025.
